title: Boost.space AgentOS
lede: Boost.space AgentOS is a workspace for running role-based AI agents that share a common data layer, skills and tool connections, steered by chat or voice.

points: Agents get roles and business context from a shared Data Layer, which they also update as they work.
Models come from a large hosted catalog or your own key, and ChatGPT or Claude can connect over MCP.
Agents reach existing business tools and can be used from Slack, WhatsApp or Teams.
An AI Wallet pays for extras such as image and video generation or purchased market data.
Commenters asked about self-hosting, approving actions before they run, and how agents learn from feedback; the material gives no answers.

sections.text: Businesses that want to hand recurring work such as competitor research or product catalog upkeep to agents while keeping data and tools in one place.
The launch comment says agents can use AI credits from an existing ChatGPT or Claude plan, where eligible, with paid Wallet credits for extra tasks. A commenter mentions an AppSumo lifetime deal.
